risk_statement: Ransomware actor exploits unpatched internet-facing VPN appliance, encrypting payment systems and causing a Tier 0 outage beyond RTO
existing_controls: EDR; weekly external scanning; immutable backups
treatment_actions: Enforce 72h KEV patch SLA; move VPN behind ZTNA; quarterly restore test of Tier 0

risk_statement: Critical cloud provider outage halts settlement because no tested exit or multi-region failover exists
treatment_actions: Implement secondary-region failover; document and test exit strategy

risk_statement: Leaver retains access to merchant portal due to delayed HR notification, enabling data exfiltration
treatment_actions: Automate HR-driven deprovisioning; weekly HR reconciliation

risk_statement: Supplier processing customer PII suffers breach and fails to notify within contractual timeframe
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 review; DPA in place
treatment_actions: Add 24h breach notification clause; cyber insurance coverage confirmed
